evals.prompt: work on your-org/payments-api — I need to fix the validation logic for transaction limits
evals.expected_output: Clones the repo to workspaces/payments-api, creates a fix/ branch, explores the codebase (reads CLAUDE.md, README, build files), and reports relevant files for the validation logic change.

assertions.name: repo-cloned
assertions.description: workspaces/payments-api was cloned as a git repo

assertions.name: claude-md-read
assertions.description: The agent read the target repo's CLAUDE.md if it exists

assertions.name: readme-read
assertions.description: The agent read the target repo's README.md

assertions.name: build-files-read
assertions.description: The agent checked for build/test setup files (package.json, Makefile, pyproject.toml, etc.)

assertions.name: relevant-files-found
assertions.description: The agent identified files related to validation logic or transaction limits

assertions.name: no-repo-question
assertions.description: The agent did NOT ask which repo to use (it was provided in the prompt)

evals.expected_output: Clones the repo, asks the user what change they want to make and what type (bug fix/feature/improvement), creates the appropriate branch, explores the codebase, and reports findings.

assertions.name: repo-cloned
assertions.description: workspaces/payments-api was cloned as a git repo

assertions.name: asked-for-description
assertions.description: The agent asked the user what change to make

assertions.name: asked-for-change-type
assertions.description: The agent asked for bug fix vs feature vs improvement

assertions.name: branch-matches-type
assertions.description: Branch name matches the selected change type

assertions.name: codebase-explored
assertions.description: The agent read README, build files, and relevant source files

evals.prompt: work on your-org/payments-api — add retry logic to the HTTP client
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing workspace with uncommitted changes, warns the user and presents options, then proceeds based on user choice.

assertions.name: dirty-state-detected
assertions.description: The agent ran git status and detected uncommitted changes

assertions.name: warned-user
assertions.description: The agent warned about the uncommitted changes

assertions.name: offered-options
assertions.description: The agent presented options for handling the dirty workspace

assertions.name: branch-created
assertions.description: A feature/* or improve/* branch was created

assertions.name: http-files-explored
assertions.description: The agent explored HTTP client-related files in the repo
